inputs.text: This is bigger than a Liberal leadership fight: it shows how readily powerful interests are protected while ordinary people are left to absorb the costs. Angus Taylor shutting down Andrew Hastie’s call to consider reform of tax advantages for gas companies and property investors suggests a party more concerned with entrenched wealth than fairness. Taylor’s refusal to say whether he supports the US and Israel’s war with Iran—or to echo Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump—also leaves the public without clarity on the use of military force. We need leaders willing to challenge concentrated power, at home and abroad.
